instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/block_a.step and /home/user/Desktop/cyl_b.step in BRL-CAD. Reorient the cylinder so its axis is along Y and passes through the center of the block, then fuse it with the block. Cut a central through hole of diameter 10 mm along Z through the fused solid. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `block_a.step`.
